                             ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District

symbols and indications as shown on Map N0.6-F in the area bounded by

       a line 298.12 feet north of and parallel to West 3D.' Street; South Canal
       Street; a line 273.12 feet north of and parallel to West 3D' Street; and
       Public Alley west of and parallel to South Canal Street;

to those of a RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District is

hereby established in the area above described.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.



Common Address of Property:          3030 South Canal Street
                      ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
   ZONING NARRATIVE FOR 3030 SOUTH CANAL STREET. CHICAGO. IL 60616
                   TYPE 1 NARRATIVE AND PLANS

Use:                 The Applicant seeks a zoning change from the current RS3 Residential
                     Single-Unit (Detached House) District to a RT4 Residential Two-Flat,
                     Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to allow the demolition of the existing
                     single-family residence and to allow the construction of a 3-stoiy residential
                     building containing three (3) dwelling units and onsite parking for three (3)
                     cars.

Project's Floor Area: 1.2

Project's Density: 3 Dwelling Units, 1,042.75 SF
(Minimum Lot Area)

Parking:             3

Setbacks:            Front: 15'

                      Rear: 40'-10"

                        • South Side Setback: 2'
